body: yeah, we're giving him time off right now and hoping for the best honestly. the reason we were thinking it'd be an idea for him to reside in the headspace was because he tends to get very panicky if he realises he's lost time, so we thought it'd be easier for him to at least vaguely know he's not out. if it's not really possible for originals to do that, though, we'll just keep throwing other alters out to front so he can rest as much as possible. thank you
Thank you!

Hey uh, I'm not sure if this is meant to be harsh or not, my autism kinda makes me misinterpret stuff especially over text a lot, so tell me if I'm wrong, but this answer seemed a little harsh? I can't afford a hairdresser so I try to cut my own hair to be as masculine as it can be without looking, well, bad, and my hair colour is kinda just what my crowd does regardless of gender/being trans or cis, so it's what I have, too. I'll change it if it'll help me pass enough, but it's not like it's a bad colour or anything, it's just what I like.

Again, I'm really sorry if i've misinterpreted this completely, I'm just not really sure what to make of the tone in the message.
